text:
Mira Patel: dropped a new console form iteration. trying a faint hollow dot as the required indicator instead of an asterisk. also mocked a small inline 'Required' label that only appears on focus. figma: https://figma.redwood/company/console-form-iter2

Samir Khan: I like the cleaner look. main worry: discoverability for users scanning many fields quickly. dots could be missed.

Priya Desai: agree. proposal: keep dot by default, reveal explicit 'Required' text on focus and show a tooltip on hover. also ensure screen readers get a clear signal (aria-required).

Alex Morgan: implementation note: only surface inline 'Required' when input is empty and focused. Otherwise keep it low-noise. Also keep aria-required on the input element regardless of the visual marker.

Kevin Liu: accessibility checklist: set aria-required="true" for required inputs, use aria-describedby to link error text, and mark error messages with role=alert so they are announced when they appear. For the summary at top, use anchor links that focus the field (tabindex=-1) to move screen readers correctly.

Mira Patel: about validation timing: we prefer showing inline validation on blur for fields with immediate constraints, but delay showing errors for empty fields until submit to avoid interrupting users filling long forms. For complex cross-field errors, show a compact summary at the top with links.

Priya Desai: on destructive actions: keep typed-confirm for workspace and org deletes. checkbox+danger-CTA is fine for batch or temporary things. always show an undo snackbar where possible (7s). copy: ask users to "Type the workspace name to confirm" rather than a generic "Type DELETE".

Alex Morgan: for typed-confirm UI, use monospace input, helper text "This cannot be undone" and aria-live polite for helper updates. For confirmation modals, trap focus and restore it after close. ensure modal has role=dialog and an accessible name.

Kevin Liu: extra nit: when a typed-confirm fails, surface the error with role=alert and ensure it is not duplicated by an identical summary. screen reader users should get a single clear message.

Mira Patel: action items:
- design: add focus-state 'Required' and hover tooltip (Priya + Mira)
- eng: add aria-required and aria-describedby for errors (Kevin + Alex)
- analytics: A/B dot vs asterisk for new orgs and capture empty-submit rate (Samir)
- PM: document typed-confirm threshold and undo policy (Mira)

design-bot: reminder: add this thread to Thu design review agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Priya Desai: tagging for accessibility review next week.

Mira Patel: I'll post updated frames by EOD Wednesday. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
